reason: The provenance persistence change replaces full historical observation reads with shared path chunks and indexed ownership. The selected tests cover exact and uncertain attribution, old-record cutover, schema upgrade without backfill, project deletion, restart, large dirty checkouts and database growth, turn and tool hook integration, the protected API write boundary, and SQLite and PostgreSQL migration paths.
exclusions: No full suites. Frontend, native, and Playwright tests are excluded because there are no UI controls, browser state, native code, or HTTP contract changes. The changed hook journey was checked separately through a disposable authenticated LAN Core with synthetic data. Unrelated automation and chat tests do not exercise this ledger.
